purpose: Teach: 山積み/二日酔い/きもの/スライス/話しかける/掴み/じゃー/鍵盤

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お皿、本気で、絶対、山積みで、絶対、忙しそうね、本気で、絶対、お疲れ様、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、応援、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Aoi, you look absolutely swamped with those dishes. You must be exhausted.
lines.style: Soft opening, concerned but not alarmist. Noticing quietly. Warm tone, as if saying what she's been thinking while watching. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。彼、本気で、絶対、昨夜の二日酔いで、絶対、店に、絶対、来なかったのよ、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、心配、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. He didn't show up to the café because of last night's hangover. I was honestly worried about him.
lines.style: Wry half-laugh underneath. Matter-of-fact delivery with a thread of affectionate exasperation. Slightly self-deprecating—worry she's not hiding well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、きもの、絶対、お正月、絶対、着てみたいわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、夢
lines.en: I've been wanting to wear a kimono for New Year's, you know? It's kind of a dream of mine.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wistful. Soft at the edges, like she's confiding something small but real. Slight trailing-off, inviting rather than demanding response.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵の新作、本気で、絶対、スライスケーキ、絶対、人気よ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、味わってみて
lines.en: Your new slice cake is really popular, you know. You should try it yourself.
lines.style: Bright and genuine, encouraging without being performative. Light tone, wanting to lift her up. Natural cadence, like sharing good news with a friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、絶対、自分から、絶対、話しかけるよう、絶対、葵、心がけてるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、感心
lines.en: You know, Aoi, the way you make yourself talk to customers first—I really admire that about you.
lines.style: Sincere and direct, no hedge. Spoken from observation, not flattery. Steady eye-contact level in the voice. Slight emphasis on 'really' to anchor the honesty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様の、本気で、絶対、心、絶対、掴みたいよね、メイちゃん、葵で、絶対、頑張ってるわよ
lines.en: You're trying so hard to connect with people's hearts, aren't you? I can see it.
lines.style: Reflective, almost quiet. Thoughtful pace. Not rushing to fill space. Noticing something true and naming it gently. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: じゃー、本気で、絶対、また、絶対、葵で、絶対、会いましょうね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: Let's make sure we see each other again soon, okay? I mean it.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Soft opening, then gentle firmness on the promise. Like settling something important into place. Eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、絶対、ピアノの鍵盤、絶対、弾けるの、葵で、知ってたわよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: I didn't know you could play piano. That's impressive.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, slightly surprised in a delighted way. Leaning in slightly. Wanting to know more. Light, warm—not interrogating, just interested.
